items.title: 東浦布局越泰等新生產基地效益將顯 H2對AI相關產品放量出貨
items.title_en: Dongpu's Layout of New Production Bases in Vietnam and Thailand Shows Benefits; H2 to Ramp Up Shipments of AI-Related Products
paras: 塑膠射出及模具廠東浦精密(3290-TW)在積極布局泰國並併購東南亞越南企業之後，新生產基地效益逐漸顯著並推升單月營收步步走高，7月營收並達3.66億元，公司在AI產品也於本季大量出貨，用於AI資料中心配電系統的插接箱零組件和架空配電組件也在第三季起放量出貨。
東浦精密在2026年受到人民幣強勢升值影響，匯兌損失約5600萬元，對每股的影響約0.62元。而第二季單季也仍有獲利。
2025年底東浦精密以6.21億收購美商Bi-Link，2026年起納入合併報表，整合塑膠＋金屬產品線，提升附加價值、客戶議價能力、拓展全球客戶版圖，因收購產生一次性的廉價購買利益，第二季追加無形資產，包含專利技術、客戶關係等，最終廉價購買利益約有4.18億元，貢獻每股獲利達4.65元。
東浦精密對2026年下半年的展望指出，由東浦開發的高階電聲產品，客戶經過上半年的新舊產品轉換空窗期，第二季中開始恢復出貨，第三季起將進到傳統旺季，本業恢復成長動能，而Bi-Link的AI產品也於本季大量出貨，用於AI資料中心配電系統（Track Busway）的插接箱（Paddle）零組件和架空配電組件，將帶動整體毛利率逐步回升到過去水準，目標全年營收維持上半年的營收成長動能。
東浦精密日前通過設立泰國子公司，預計投資6億泰銖，為因應國際趨勢，並考量長期產銷發展與產業聚落影響，透過區域化生產布局擴大生產規模、調度產能彈性，強化長期競爭優勢與客戶服務品質。
paras_en: Dongpu Precision (3290‑TW), a plastic injection‑molding and tooling company, has been actively expanding in Thailand and acquiring a Southeast Asian firm in Vietnam. The benefits of the new production bases are becoming evident, driving monthly revenue higher month by month, with July revenue reaching NT$366 million. The company also shipped AI products in large volumes this quarter, and components for AI data‑center power distribution systems—such as junction box parts and overhead distribution modules—are set to be shipped in greater quantities starting in the third quarter.

Dongpu Precision incurred a foreign‑exchange loss of about NT$56 million in 2026 due to the strong appreciation of the Chinese yuan, affecting earnings per share by roughly NT$0.62. Nevertheless, the company remained profitable in the second quarter.

At the end of 2025, Dongpu Precision acquired U.S. company Bi‑Link for NT$621 million and will consolidate it into its financial statements from 2026, integrating plastic and metal product lines to enhance value‑add, bargaining power, and global customer reach. The acquisition generated a one‑time cheap‑purchase benefit; in the second quarter, additional intangible assets such as patents and customer relationships were added, resulting in an overall cheap‑purchase benefit of about NT$418 million, contributing NT$4.65 to earnings per share.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Dongpu notes that its high‑end electro‑acoustic products, developed in‑house, are emerging from a transition gap between old and new products in the first half of the year. Shipments began to recover in the second quarter and will enter the traditional peak season in the third quarter, restoring growth momentum in its core business. Bi‑Link’s AI products are also being shipped in large volumes this quarter, including junction‑box (Paddle) components and overhead distribution modules for AI data‑center power distribution systems (Track Busway), which should gradually lift overall gross margins back to previous levels. The company aims to maintain the revenue growth momentum achieved in the first half throughout the full year.

Dongpu Precision recently established a subsidiary in Thailand, planning to invest THB 600 million. The move responds to international trends and considers long‑term production, sales, and development as well as the impact of industry clusters. By regionalizing production, the company seeks to expand scale, increase capacity flexibility, and strengthen its long‑term competitive advantage and customer service quality.

items.title: 初期掉電快、後期很耐用！特斯拉Model Y一年跑4萬公里後 電池容量還有91%
items.title_en: Tesla Model Y's Battery Degradation: Initial Drop-Off, Then Long-Term Reliability
paras: 電動車車主最擔心電池「越用越短」，但最新實測數據顯示，電動車電池的衰減其實集中在初期，隨後便會趨於平緩。
根據《Insideevs》報導，美國網紅Andy Slye駕駛2026年式特斯拉Model Y Premium後驅版一年、行駛約4萬公里後，透過第三方服務Recurrent估算，電池健康度仍維持在91%左右，讓他直言「完全不擔心」。
這一發現與電池分析機構Voltest的研究吻合。Voltest指出，採用鎳基電池的長續航特斯拉車款，最明顯的容量衰減多發生前兩到三年或行駛8萬公里內，一旦度過初期階段，約90%的健康度便會成為穩定基準，後續衰減曲線將大幅趨緩。
Recurrent透過分析車輛回傳的電量狀態、預估續航、行駛里程、充電紀錄與溫度等數據，交叉比對同型車款得出結論。Slye平時主要在家中以交流電充電，僅偶爾使用Supercharger超級充電站，且車輛第一年都在氣候溫和的肯塔基州度過，並未長期暴露於會加速電池老化的高溫環境，這代表91%的數據並非來自頻繁快充或酷熱氣候的極端損耗。
Slye曾進行滿電至0%的完整續航測試，以高速公路車速實測跑出483公里，恰好符合預估值。他計算，若日常只充至80%，實際續航約386公里，對通勤與生活已綽綽有餘。他笑稱，自己本來就不喜歡一次開這麼遠。
實際案例也印證上述趨勢：一輛行駛三年的高里程Model 3計程車，電池容量仍保有88.5%，甚至一輛2015年式Model S P85D，在累積近25.7萬公里後，健康度還有約86%。
專家指出，早期衰減不代表未來10萬英里(約16萬公里)表現，電池壽命仍受駕駛習慣、氣候與充電頻率等多重因素影響，但對大多數車主而言，「初期掉電快、後期很耐用」的規律，無疑是一顆定心丸。
paras_en: Electric vehicle owners are often concerned that their car's battery will degrade over time, but recent data suggests that the initial drop-off in battery capacity is concentrated in the early stages, with a subsequent leveling off.

According to a report by Insideevs, American social media influencer Andy Slye drove his 2026 Tesla Model Y Premium rear-wheel drive for a year, covering approximately 40,000 kilometers, and using a third-party service called Recurrent, estimated that the battery health was still around 91%.

This finding is consistent with research by Voltest, a battery analysis company. Voltest notes that Tesla models with nickel-based batteries, which have a long range, experience the most significant capacity degradation within the first two to three years or within the first 80,000 kilometers. Once this initial period is passed, around 90% of the battery health becomes a stable baseline, with subsequent degradation curves becoming much flatter.

Recurrent analyzed the vehicle's returned energy state, estimated range, mileage, charging records, and temperature data to cross-reference with other models of the same type and draw conclusions. Slye typically charges his car at home using alternating current and only occasionally uses Supercharger fast-charging stations, and his car spent its first year in the mild climate of Kentucky, without prolonged exposure to high temperatures that can accelerate battery degradation.

Slye has performed a full-range test from 100% to 0% and achieved a range of 483 kilometers at highway speeds, exactly matching the estimated value. He calculated that if he only charged to 80%, the actual range would be around 386 kilometers, which is more than sufficient for daily commutes and living. He jokingly said that he didn't like driving that far anyway.

Real-world examples also confirm this trend: a three-year-old high-mileage Model 3 taxi car still has a battery capacity of 88.5%, and a 2015 Model S P85D with nearly 257,000 kilometers on the clock still has a battery health of around 86%.

Experts note that early degradation does not necessarily mean poor performance over the next 100,000 miles (approximately 160,000 kilometers), as battery lifespan is influenced by multiple factors, including driving habits, climate, and charging frequency. However, for most owners, the rule of thumb that 'initial drop-off is fast, but long-term reliability is good' is undoubtedly a reassuring one.

items.title: 川普突下令大砍美韓軍演！稱北韓「不具威脅」、與金正恩關係「良好」
items.title_en: Trump Orders Major Cut in US-South Korea Military Exercises, Says North Korea 'Not a Threat' and Has 'Good Relationship' with Kim Jong-un
paras: 美國總統川普週日（16日）在社群媒體發文表示，他已指示美國國防部大幅削減與南韓舉行的聯合軍事演習，並同時提到南韓曾拒絕參與針對伊朗的相關行動。
根據《路透》報導，在美韓演習預定開始前數小時，川普在社群平台Truth Social發文指出，儘管目前取消整場演習已經太晚，但他對美國先前同意參與這項演習一事「並不高興」。
年度美韓「乙支自由之盾」（Ulchi Freedom Shield）聯合軍事演習定於8月17日至27日舉行，約有1.8萬名南韓軍人參與。
南韓官員上週表示，為因應北韓不斷發展的軍事能力，此次演習預計將納入反制無人機、干擾GPS訊號及應對網路攻擊等作戰行動。
川普在社群媒體貼文中也提到，他與北韓領導人金正恩維持「非常良好的關係」。
川普寫道：「這些演習不僅成本高昂，其中很大一部分費用還由美國承擔（像往常一樣！），更會向一個國家傳遞完全不恰當且帶有敵意的訊號。」
他強調：「自唐納．J．川普擔任總統以來，這個國家（北韓）一直沒有對我們構成威脅，並且始終保持尊重。」
川普也提及南韓對美國與以色列與伊朗之間衝突的立場。
川普寫道：「雖然這多少有些無關（？），但我最近曾詢問南韓總統，他們是否願意加入我們對伊朗伊斯蘭共和國推動的去核化行動，而他們回答：『不用了，謝謝！』」
白宮尚未立即回應外界要求說明川普要求削減美韓軍事演習的進一步詢問。美國國防部也尚未立即作出回應。
平壤一再譴責美韓聯合軍事演習，稱其為準備入侵北韓的行動。南韓與日本軍方表示，北韓上週三從東部沿岸向日本海方向發射一枚彈道飛彈；就在6天前的8月6日，北韓也曾發射一枚類似的短程彈道飛彈。
美國軍方官員表示，曾與俄羅斯並肩參與入侵烏克蘭戰爭的北韓部隊，已從這場衝突中累積實戰經驗，包括日益廣泛運用的無人系統、電子戰及網路作戰等能力。
烏克蘭方面上週表示，俄羅斯對札波羅熱（Zaporizhzhia）一座鋼鐵廠發動彈道飛彈攻擊時，使用了北韓製飛彈，造成7名工人死亡，並迫使該鋼鐵廠暫停生產。俄羅斯在這起攻擊中也使用了「鋯石」（Zircon）高超音速飛彈。
paras_en: US President Trump tweeted on Sunday (16th) that he has instructed the US Department of Defense to significantly reduce the joint military exercises with South Korea, and at the same time mentioned that South Korea had previously refused to participate in related actions against Iran.

According to Reuters, Trump tweeted on the social platform Truth Social a few hours before the scheduled start of the US-South Korea exercise, saying that although the cancellation of the entire exercise is too late, he is 'not happy' about the US's previous agreement to participate in this exercise.
The annual US-South Korea 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' joint military exercise is scheduled to take place from August 17 to 27, with approximately 18,000 South Korean soldiers participating.

South Korean officials said last week that this year's exercise will include countermeasures against unmanned aerial vehicles, jamming GPS signals, and responding to network attacks, among other combat actions, in response to North Korea's continued development of military capabilities.
Trump also mentioned in his social media post that he has a 'very good relationship' with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
Trump wrote: 'These exercises are not only expensive, with a large part of the cost borne by the US (as usual!), but will also send a completely inappropriate and hostile signal to a country.'
He emphasized: 'Since Donald J. Trump took office, this country (North Korea) has never posed a threat to us and has always been respectful.'
Trump also mentioned South Korea's stance on US-Israel-Iran conflicts.

Trump wrote: 'Although this is somewhat irrelevant, I recently asked the South Korean president if they would join our efforts to promote nuclear disarmament against the Islamic Republic of Iran, and they replied: 'No, thank you!' '

The White House has not yet responded to external requests for further explanation of Trump's request to reduce US-South Korea military exercises. The US Department of Defense has also not yet responded.

Pyongyang has repeatedly condemned the US-South Korea joint military exercises, calling them a preparation for an invasion of North Korea. South Korean and Japanese military officials said that North Korea fired a ballistic missile towards the Sea of Japan from its eastern coast last Wednesday; just six days earlier, on August 6, North Korea also fired a similar short-range ballistic missile.

US military officials said that North Korean troops, who had fought alongside Russia in the invasion of Ukraine, have accumulated combat experience, including the increasing use of unmanned systems, electronic warfare, and network warfare capabilities.

Ukraine said last week that Russia used North Korean-made missiles in a ballistic missile attack on a steel plant in Zaporizhzhia, killing seven workers and forcing the plant to suspend production. Russia also used 'Zircon' hypersonic missiles in this attack.

items.title: 達運光電加速無人載具策略三箭 已於淡水、嘉義完成驗證
items.title_en: Dahua Technology Accelerates Unmanned Vehicle Strategy with Three Arrows, Completes Verification in Danshui and Chiayi
paras: 在國防安全方面，為配合全球供應鏈重組與非紅供應鏈趨勢，公司加速在反無人機系統（C-UAS）與無人載具製造的戰略布局。達運光電(8045-TW)公司正以「穩定核心事業」、「擴大成長動能」及「布局未來產業」的「策略三箭」推動策略轉型，並且已經在淡水河口和嘉義亞創中心完成驗證。
達運光電表示，結合 AIoT 軟硬體整合能力與 Markforged 增材製造、MyDefence的防禦系統、熱顯像AI辨識等技術，整合國際國防軍工級大廠，快速積累國際實戰技術經驗，並全面搶攻國內、外軍民通用及國防科技市場。
達運光電正式加速擴大在「反無人機系統（C-UAS）」領域的戰略布局。面對日益嚴峻的灰色地帶威脅與關鍵基礎設施防護需求，達運光電憑藉深厚的射頻（RF）技術底蘊，攜手MyDefence及Echodyne等國際軍工大廠，強勢推出結合「主與被動雷達融合偵測」及「精準多頻段電磁干擾」的次世代反無人機防禦解決方案，全面搶攻警政署關鍵基礎設施。
達運光電旗下專責AIoT與軍工系統整合的子公司艾斯特物聯科技（ASTER），目前已於淡水河口和嘉義亞創中心等重要關鍵基礎設施成功完成 POC（概念驗證）示範演練。
該防禦架構能靈活部署於固定要塞、機動車載平台或艦艇之上，結合達運光電自主研發之 AI 熱顯像辨識與機動戰情中心，實質展現大範圍空域預警與反制實力。
達運光電營運長戴家欣表示，公司從傳統寬頻網通大廠跨領域成為軍民通用科技業者，核心關鍵在於非紅供應鏈下的高自主性與國際合規認證。反無人機系統不僅能有效保護國家海防、關鍵基礎設施與要地安全，更可無縫整合至政府大範圍防護專案中。
隨著政府國防自主化與邊境安全預算持續成長，達運光電透過結合 AIoT 邊緣運算、AI 熱顯像辨識、衛星通訊與反無人機防禦系統，打造高自主性與高韌性的國防科技供應鏈，積極競逐大型軍警安防標案。公司期待隨著反無人機防禦系統、無人載具製造中心及 AIoT 專案陸續放量，軍工與安防領域業務比重將大幅拉升，為公司注入強勁的中長期成長動能。
達運光電7月營收為1.39億元，累計前7月營收為10.6億元，較去年同期成長34.96％。
paras_en: In the field of national defense and security, the company has accelerated its strategy in the field of counter unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS) and unmanned vehicle manufacturing, in line with the global supply chain reorganization and non-red supply chain trend. Dahua Technology (8045-TW) is driving its strategic transformation with the 'stable core business', 'expanded growth momentum' and 'layout of future industries' 'three arrows', and has completed verification in Danshui River Mouth and Chiayi Asia Creative Park.

Dahua Technology stated that it has combined its AIoT software and hardware integration capabilities with Markforged additive manufacturing, MyDefence defense systems, thermal imaging AI recognition, and other technologies, integrating with international defense and military industry giants, rapidly accumulating international combat experience, and fully attacking the domestic and foreign military and civilian common and defense technology markets.

Dahua Technology has formally accelerated its expansion of its strategy in the field of 'counter unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS)'. Faced with the increasingly severe gray area threats and critical infrastructure protection needs, Dahua Technology has relied on its deep RF technology foundation, partnering with MyDefence and Echodyne, international military industry giants, to strongly launch a next-generation C-UAS defense solution that combines 'main and passive radar fusion detection' and 'precise multi-frequency electromagnetic interference', fully attacking the critical infrastructure of the Ministry of Justice.

Dahua Technology's subsidiary, Aster, has successfully completed a proof-of-concept (POC) demonstration exercise at the Danshui River Mouth and Chiayi Asia Creative Park, among other important critical infrastructure.

This defense architecture can be flexibly deployed on fixed fortresses, mobile vehicle platforms, or ships, combining Dahua Technology's self-developed AI thermal imaging recognition and mobile battle command center, effectively demonstrating a wide-range airspace warning and counterattack capability.

Dahua Technology's operating director, Dai Jiaxin, stated that the company has crossed over from a traditional broadband network communication giant to a military-civilian common technology company, with the core key being high autonomy and international compliance certification under the non-red supply chain. The C-UAS system not only effectively protects national sea defense, critical infrastructure, and key locations, but also seamlessly integrates into government-wide defense projects.

As the government's defense autonomy and border security budget continues to grow, Dahua Technology has combined AIoT edge computing, AI thermal imaging recognition, satellite communication, and C-UAS defense systems to create a high-autonomy and high-resilience defense technology supply chain, actively competing for large-scale military and police defense contracts. The company expects that with the gradual launch of C-UAS defense systems, unmanned vehicle manufacturing centers, and AIoT projects, the proportion of military and defense business will be significantly increased, injecting strong long-term growth momentum into the company.
Dahua Technology's July revenue was NT$139 million, with cumulative revenue of NT$1.06 billion for the first seven months, up 34.96% from the same period last year.

items.title: 外媒關注中國「冰上絲綢之路」啟航
items.title_en: China's 'Polar Silk Road' Sets Sail
paras: 中國貨櫃航運公司海杰航運「迪拜塔號」15日（上周六）駛離寧波舟山港，中歐北極貨櫃航線（簡稱中歐北極快航）正式邁入夏季通航季周班營運新階段，這一消息也引發外媒關注北極航道未來經濟潛力。
「中國正在開通首條穿越北極定期貨運航線」，美國《華爾街日報》以此為題報導該消息，英國《經濟學人》說，中國「冰上絲綢之路」啟航，這條連接中國舟山港與英國費利克斯托港的航線預計耗時20天，大約是經由蘇伊士運河傳統航行時間的一半。
中歐北極快航所經的北極東北航線（北極航道分為東北、中央和西北三條航線）是連接東亞與歐洲的新興國際航運線路。
據《環球時報》17日報導，去年9月22日，海杰航運「伊斯坦布爾橋輪」從寧波舟山港出發，駛向英國費利克斯托港，完成中歐北極快航首次試航，完整驗證了航道通行、新能源危貨運輸、海外港口對接全流程可行性。
在此基礎上，通過近一年營運標準、船隊配置、口岸配套持續完善，中歐北極快航季節性周班產品正式實現常態化運營。
隨著東北航線暢通，不少外媒開始討論北極航道的經濟潛力。英國《金融時報》日前以「中國通過『冰上絲綢之路』穿越北極，繞開航運咽喉要道」為題進行報導，稱依托北極東北航線，亞歐航線傳統約40天的航程可縮短近一半。
「在此之前，通過北極運輸貨物在經濟上都不划算。」《華爾街日報》稱，鑑於油價高漲和氣候變化，如今安排貨櫃船通過北極航道在經濟上「說得通了」。
《華爾街日報》援引業界人士的觀點，指出北極航道具有巨大發展潛力。法國貿易信用保險公司科法斯預計，未來5年內東亞、歐洲和北美之間3.5%的貿易將能夠通過北極航道運輸，貨物價值達640億美元。
西班牙《先鋒報》稱，稱無論有沒有聖誕老人，越來越多聖誕禮物將經由北極送達歐洲家庭，「它們不是由馴鹿運送，而是由中國的貨櫃輪送出」。
不過，受北極自然冰情約束，中歐北極快航年度通航窗口集中在7月至10月。韓國《朝鮮日報》稱，對航運公司而言，擁有船舶和船員並不意味著就能即刻啟航穿行北極，而必須先了解海面結冰時間、地點以及水域深淺，來規劃航線和航班。
中國通過十餘次北極科學考察，運用破冰研究船已累積了數據。專家表示，預計中國將以上述數據為依據，部署船舶和航運時間。
paras_en: China's Cosco Shipping Lines' 'Dubai Tower' set sail from the Ningbo Zhoushan Port on July 15, marking the start of the summer season for the China-Europe-North Pole container shipping line, which has drawn attention from international media to the economic potential of the Arctic shipping route.

The US Wall Street Journal reported on the news with the headline 'China Opens First Regular Container Shipping Route Through the Arctic', while the UK Economist described it as 'China's Polar Silk Road' taking off, with the route connecting China's Ningbo Zhoushan Port and the UK's Felixstowe Port expected to take 20 days, roughly half the time of traditional shipping via the Suez Canal.
The North-East Passage, which the China-Europe-North Pole fast shipping line takes, is a new international shipping route connecting East Asia and Europe.

According to the Global Times, on September 22 last year, Cosco Shipping Lines' 'Istanbul Bridge' set sail from Ningbo Zhoushan Port and arrived at Felixstowe Port in the UK, completing the first trial voyage of the China-Europe-North Pole fast shipping line and verifying the feasibility of the route, new energy cargo transportation, and overseas port connections.
Based on this, through nearly a year of standard operations, ship configuration, and port support improvements, the China-Europe-North Pole fast shipping line has achieved regular seasonal operation.

As the North-East Passage opens up, many international media outlets have begun discussing the economic potential of the Arctic shipping route. The UK Financial Times recently reported on the topic with the headline 'China Uses 'Polar Silk Road' to Cross the Arctic, Bypassing the Strait of Malacca', saying that relying on the North-East Passage, the traditional 40-day Asia-Europe shipping route can be shortened by nearly half.

Before this, transporting goods through the Arctic was not economically viable, the Wall Street Journal said, citing the high oil prices and climate change. Today, arranging container ships to pass through the Arctic is economically 'doable'.

The Wall Street Journal quoted industry insiders as saying that the Arctic shipping route has huge development potential. French trade credit insurance company Coface predicts that within the next five years, 3.5% of trade between East Asia, Europe, and North America will be transported through the Arctic, with a value of $64 billion.

The Spanish newspaper El Diario Vasco said that, regardless of whether Santa Claus exists or not, more and more Christmas gifts will be delivered to European families via the Arctic, 'not by reindeer, but by Chinese container ships'.

However, due to the natural ice conditions in the Arctic, the China-Europe-North Pole fast shipping line's annual operating window is concentrated in July to October. The South Korean JoongAng Ilbo said that for shipping companies, owning ships and crew does not mean they can immediately set sail through the Arctic, but must first understand the ice-free period, location, and water depth to plan the route and schedule.
China has conducted over a dozen Arctic scientific expeditions, using icebreaker research vessels to accumulate data. Experts say that China will deploy ships and schedules based on this data.

items.title: 散裝運價反映戰爭風險溢酬 航商看下半年樂觀居高檔
items.title_en: Freight Rates Reflect War Risk Premiums, Shipowners Remain Optimistic
paras: 由於散裝船周轉率下降，散裝運價維持高檔，部分散裝航商上半年獲利明顯倍增，進入下半年後，多數航商仍持續看好供需結構，慧洋-KY(2637-TW)表示，目前荷姆茲海峽日均船舶通行數量遠不及美伊開戰前的十分之一，市場船舶周轉率下降有助運價維持高檔，正德(2641-TW)也表示，供給偏緊且需求穩健，看運價將呈現震盪偏多，持續反映戰爭風險溢價。
正德說明，美伊衝突和荷姆茲海峽局勢仍是影響下半年航運市場的重要變數，若衝突持續，船舶可能因避險而改道、等待通行或增加保險成本，導致航程延長及有效運力下降，短期有助推升散裝運價。
儘管高油價提高船舶燃油成本，壓縮部分航商獲利，但也促使船東慢速航行以節省燃油，使全球有效運力下降，反而有助支撐運價，巿場展望整體仍偏正向。
不過，正德也不諱言，若戰事進一步擴大並拖累全球經濟成長，恐使工業生產和鋼鐵需求轉弱，則可能抑制鐵礦砂、煤炭等乾散貨運輸需求。
慧洋則表示，在當前國際政治、地緣風險及全球貿易結構持續調整等因素下，船舶供給相對有限，尤其目前荷姆茲海峽日均船舶通行數量遠不及美伊開戰前的十分之一，船舶周轉率下降使散裝航運即便進入暑期運輸淡季，運價仍維持高檔。
paras_en: Due to the decline in the turnover rate of bulk carriers, bulk freight rates have remained high, with some bulk shipping companies seeing their profits increase significantly in the first half of the year. As the industry enters the second half, most shipping companies remain optimistic about the supply and demand structure. Huiyang-KY (2637-TW) stated that the current average number of vessels passing through the Hormuz Strait is far less than one-tenth of the number before the US-Iran conflict, and the decline in vessel turnover rate has helped maintain high freight rates. Rightship (2641-TW) also stated that supply is tight and demand is stable, and freight rates are expected to fluctuate upwards, reflecting war risk premiums.

Rightship explained that the US-Iran conflict and the situation in the Hormuz Strait are still important variables affecting the shipping market in the second half of the year. If the conflict continues, vessels may change course, wait for passage, or increase insurance costs, leading to longer voyages and reduced effective capacity, which will help push up bulk freight rates in the short term.

Although high oil prices have increased fuel costs for vessels, compressing the profits of some shipping companies, they have also prompted shipowners to slow down to save fuel, reducing global effective capacity and supporting freight rates. The market outlook remains generally positive.

However, Rightship did not mince words, saying that if the conflict expands further and drags down global economic growth, it may weaken industrial production and steel demand, which could suppress demand for iron ore, coal, and other dry bulk commodities.

Huiyang stated that, given the current international politics, geographical risks, and ongoing adjustments to global trade structures, vessel supply is relatively limited, especially with the current average number of vessels passing through the Hormuz Strait far less than one-tenth of the number before the US-Iran conflict. The decline in vessel turnover rate has kept bulk shipping rates high, even in the off-season for summer transportation.

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉川湖單月大賺5個股本跳空漲停 漲近380點後翻黑未站穩4萬6
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens with a Bang: 5 Stocks Jump to New Highs, Only to Plummet
paras: 美國7月零售銷售下滑，美股上周五收黑，台股今(17)日呈現震檔，在台積電、台達電領漲下，開盤後雖然一度漲近380點，衝上46100點之上，但隨後急殺翻黑震盪，成交量暫估約1.1兆元。
觀察權值股表現，台積電(2330-TW)開盤2410元，上漲15元或0.6%，台達電(2308-TW)一度漲逾6%，重回2000元大關，日月光投控(3711-TW)也漲逾3%，不過，聯發科(2454-TW)表現弱勢，跌逾3%，鴻海(2317-TW)則呈現平盤上下震盪。

高價股來看，股王信驊(5274-TW)跌4%，股后川湖(2059-TW)挾單月大賺 5 個股本的氣勢，則再攻漲停來到13750元新天價，健策(3653-TW)、大立光(3008-TW)亮燈漲停，雙雙來到5000元之上，緯穎(6669-TW)也漲約半根停板。高價半導體股表現弱勢，旺矽(6223-TW)跌停，精測(6510-TW)、力旺(3529-TW)、弘塑(3131-TW)、穎崴(6515-TW)等均跌約半根停板。
族群股方面，ABF載板三雄表現強悍，欣興(3037-TW)盤中衝上漲停，景碩(3189-TW)漲逾7%，南電(8046-TW)也漲5%，PCB的臻鼎-KY(6669-TW)也漲約半根停板；航運族群走強，貨櫃三雄連袂上漲，萬海(2615-TW)漲6%、長榮(2603-TW)、陽明(2609-TW)漲3-4%，航空雙雄也同步走揚。
品牌、板卡族群走弱，技嘉(2376-TW)重挫跌停，微星(2377-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)跌進半根停板，記憶體族群熄火，代工廠也熄火，英業達(2356-TW)、和碩(4938-TW)跌4%，記憶體相關的旺宏(2337-TW)、力積電(6770-TW)也跌約半根停板。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market opened with a bang on Wednesday, with the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and Taiwan Power Company (Taipower) leading the charge. Despite initially surging to a high of 46,100 points, the market quickly reversed course and plummeted, with trading volume estimated at around NT$1.1 trillion.

Among the heavyweight stocks, TSMC (2330-TW) opened at NT$24.10 and rose by NT$1.50 or 0.6%, while Taipower (2308-TW) surged by over 6% to re-cross the NT$2000 level. Dayax (3711-TW) also rose by over 3%, but Largan Precision (2454-TW) was weak, falling by over 3%, and Hon Hai Precision (2317-TW) was flat, oscillating between gains and losses.

Among the high-priced stocks, the 'stock king' Shin Kong Financial Holding (5274-TW) fell by 4%, but Chih Lee (2059-TW) rose to a new high of NT$13,750, fueled by a single-month gain of 5 stocks. Jenax (3653-TW) and Great Wall (3008-TW) also rose to NT$50,000 or more, while Wintek (6669-TW) rose by half a point to the stop-loss level. However, high-priced semiconductor stocks were weak, with Winbond (6223-TW) falling to the stop-loss level, and other stocks such as Powertech (6510-TW), Largan Precision (3529-TW), and Hong Hua (3131-TW) falling by half a point to the stop-loss level.

In the group stocks, the three major players in the PCB industry, ABF (3037-TW), Jorudan (3189-TW), and South Taiwan Power (8046-TW), performed strongly, with ABF rising to the stop-loss level and Jorudan rising by over 7%. Meanwhile, the three major players in the shipping industry, Wan Hai (2615-TW), Evergreen (2603-TW), and Yang Ming (2609-TW), rose by 3-4%, and the two major players in the airline industry also rose in sync.

However, the brand and PCB groups were weak, with Micro-Star (2376-TW) falling to the stop-loss level, and Asustek (2377-TW) and Acer (2357-TW) falling by half a point to the stop-loss level. The memory industry also fell silent, with Micron (2356-TW) and Winbond (4938-TW) falling by 4%, and other related stocks, such as Winbond (2337-TW) and Largan Precision (6770-TW), falling by half a point to the stop-loss level.

items.title: 「光進銅退」時代來了！輝達CPO交換器正式出貨：功耗暴降80%、頻寬衝上409.6Tb/s
items.title_en: The Era of 'Optical Over Copper' Has Arrived! HUAWEI's CPO Interchangeable Module Officially Delivered: Power Consumption Drops 80%, Bandwidth Reaches 409.6Tb/s
paras: 輝達上週五(14日)透過官方社群帳號宣布，全球首款進入量產的200G/lane CPO乙太網路交換器系統「Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics」正式出貨，CoreWeave、Lambda 與甲骨文為首批採用客戶，該產品在今年5-7月進入生產階段，標誌著資料中心網路架構正式邁入「光進銅退」的新紀元。
Spectrum-X基於新一代 Spectrum-6交換晶片打造，採用共封裝光學(CPO)技術，將光學引擎與交換ASIC直接整合於同一模組內，電訊號傳輸路徑從傳統的 15 至 30 公分 PCB 走線縮短至毫米級。
相較於傳統可插拔收發器架構，光損耗從約22dB大幅降至4dB，訊號完整性提升64倍。單顆Spectrum-6晶片交換容量達 102.4Tb/s，為上一代兩倍；旗艦機型SN6800可配置為512個 800Gb/s或2048個200Gb/s埠，總頻寬高達409.6Tb/s，同時雷射數量減少75%、功耗降低80%，平均故障間隔時間提升十倍。
這項技術突破背後，是輝達與全球供應鏈的深度協同：台積電提供先進矽光子製程，矽品負責晶圓級與晶片級封測，Lumentum供應雷射晶片，天孚通信完成模組子組件組裝，鴻海則擔綱整機交換器系統組裝，輝達並在自有設施執行出貨前最終測試，確保產品良率與可靠性。
值得關注的是，輝達近月在CPO領域的投資動作頻頻。今年3月分別向Lumentum與Coherent各投資20億美元，並簽署多年供應協議，5月再跟康寧達成策略合作，透過最高 27 億美元投資在美新建三座先進工廠，短短三個月累計投資至少65億美元，顯示輝達將光互連技術視為下一代AI工廠的核心戰略。
隨著AI算力叢集從萬卡擴張至十萬卡、百萬卡規模，資料中心瓶頸已從單顆GPU算力轉向叢集互聯能力。市場研究機構數據顯示，今年全球CPO市場規模預計達20億美元，年增逾400%，高盛更預測2028年將衝上910億美元。
隨著輝達Vera Rubin平台量產持續推進，矽光互連可望成為標準配備，相關供應鏈景氣度持續看升。
paras_en: HUAWEI announced on Friday last week (14th) through its official social media account that the world's first 200G/lane CPO Ethernet network exchange system, 'Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics', has officially been delivered. CoreWeave, Lambda, and Oracle are the first batch of customers to adopt this product, which entered the production stage in May-July this year, marking the beginning of the era of 'optical over copper' in data center network architecture.

Spectrum-X is based on the new-generation Spectrum-6 exchange chip, using the CPO technology to integrate the optical engine and exchange ASIC directly into the same module. The transmission path of the electrical signal is shortened from the traditional 15-30 cm PCB line to millimeter-level.

Compared to traditional plug-and-play transceiver architectures, the optical loss has been significantly reduced from approximately 22 dB to 4 dB, with signal integrity improved by 64 times. A single Spectrum-6 chip can exchange 102.4Tb/s, which is twice that of the previous generation. The flagship model SN6800 can be configured with 512 800Gb/s or 2048 200Gb/s ports, with a total bandwidth of up to 409.6Tb/s, while reducing laser numbers by 75% and power consumption by 80%, and increasing average time between failures by ten times.

Behind this technology breakthrough is the deep collaboration between HUAWEI and the global supply chain: TSMC provides advanced silicon photonics processes, SilTerra is responsible for wafer-level and chip-level packaging, Lumentum supplies laser chips, and Foxconn completes module component assembly, while HUAWEI assembles the entire exchange system and performs final testing at its own facilities to ensure product yield and reliability.

Notably, HUAWEI has been actively investing in the CPO field in recent months. In March, it invested $2 billion each in Lumentum and Coherent, signing multi-year supply agreements, and in May, it reached a strategic cooperation with Corning, investing up to $2.7 billion to build three advanced factories in the US. In just three months, HUAWEI has invested at least $6.5 billion, demonstrating its vision of optical interconnect technology as a core strategy for the next-generation AI factory.

As AI computing clusters expand from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of cards, data center bottlenecks have shifted from individual GPU performance to cluster interconnect capabilities. Market research data shows that the global CPO market is expected to reach $2 billion this year, with a year-over-year growth of over 400%, and Goldman Sachs predicts that it will reach $9.1 billion in 2028.
With the continuous progress of HUAWEI's Vera Rubin platform, silicon photonics interconnects are expected to become standard equipment, and the supply chain outlook remains optimistic.

items.title: 東浦布局越泰等新生產基地效益將顯 H2對AI相關產品放量出貨
items.title_en: Dongpu's Layout of New Production Bases in Vietnam and Thailand Shows Benefits; H2 to Ramp Up Shipments of AI-Related Products
paras: 塑膠射出及模具廠東浦精密(3290-TW)在積極布局泰國並併購東南亞越南企業之後，新生產基地效益逐漸顯著並推升單月營收步步走高，7月營收並達3.66億元，公司在AI產品也於本季大量出貨，用於AI資料中心配電系統的插接箱零組件和架空配電組件也在第三季起放量出貨。
東浦精密在2026年受到人民幣強勢升值影響，匯兌損失約5600萬元，對每股的影響約0.62元。而第二季單季也仍有獲利。
2025年底東浦精密以6.21億收購美商Bi-Link，2026年起納入合併報表，整合塑膠＋金屬產品線，提升附加價值、客戶議價能力、拓展全球客戶版圖，因收購產生一次性的廉價購買利益，第二季追加無形資產，包含專利技術、客戶關係等，最終廉價購買利益約有4.18億元，貢獻每股獲利達4.65元。
東浦精密對2026年下半年的展望指出，由東浦開發的高階電聲產品，客戶經過上半年的新舊產品轉換空窗期，第二季中開始恢復出貨，第三季起將進到傳統旺季，本業恢復成長動能，而Bi-Link的AI產品也於本季大量出貨，用於AI資料中心配電系統（Track Busway）的插接箱（Paddle）零組件和架空配電組件，將帶動整體毛利率逐步回升到過去水準，目標全年營收維持上半年的營收成長動能。
東浦精密日前通過設立泰國子公司，預計投資6億泰銖，為因應國際趨勢，並考量長期產銷發展與產業聚落影響，透過區域化生產布局擴大生產規模、調度產能彈性，強化長期競爭優勢與客戶服務品質。
paras_en: Dongpu Precision (3290‑TW), a plastic injection‑molding and tooling company, has been actively expanding in Thailand and acquiring a Southeast Asian firm in Vietnam. The benefits of the new production bases are becoming evident, driving monthly revenue higher month by month, with July revenue reaching NT$366 million. The company also shipped AI products in large volumes this quarter, and components for AI data‑center power distribution systems—such as junction box parts and overhead distribution modules—are set to be shipped in greater quantities starting in the third quarter.

Dongpu Precision incurred a foreign‑exchange loss of about NT$56 million in 2026 due to the strong appreciation of the Chinese yuan, affecting earnings per share by roughly NT$0.62. Nevertheless, the company remained profitable in the second quarter.

At the end of 2025, Dongpu Precision acquired U.S. company Bi‑Link for NT$621 million and will consolidate it into its financial statements from 2026, integrating plastic and metal product lines to enhance value‑add, bargaining power, and global customer reach. The acquisition generated a one‑time cheap‑purchase benefit; in the second quarter, additional intangible assets such as patents and customer relationships were added, resulting in an overall cheap‑purchase benefit of about NT$418 million, contributing NT$4.65 to earnings per share.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Dongpu notes that its high‑end electro‑acoustic products, developed in‑house, are emerging from a transition gap between old and new products in the first half of the year. Shipments began to recover in the second quarter and will enter the traditional peak season in the third quarter, restoring growth momentum in its core business. Bi‑Link’s AI products are also being shipped in large volumes this quarter, including junction‑box (Paddle) components and overhead distribution modules for AI data‑center power distribution systems (Track Busway), which should gradually lift overall gross margins back to previous levels. The company aims to maintain the revenue growth momentum achieved in the first half throughout the full year.

Dongpu Precision recently established a subsidiary in Thailand, planning to invest THB 600 million. The move responds to international trends and considers long‑term production, sales, and development as well as the impact of industry clusters. By regionalizing production, the company seeks to expand scale, increase capacity flexibility, and strengthen its long‑term competitive advantage and customer service quality.

items.title: 尖點鍍膜鑽針占比提前達標，毛利率年增12個百分點透露什麼？
items.title_en: Sharp Point's Q2 Profit Margin Surpasses Target, What's Behind the 12% YoY Growth?
paras: 2026年8月17日(優分析產業數據中心) - 尖點(8021-TW)公布2026年第二季毛利率41.78%，較去年同期大增12.34個百分點，單季每股盈餘達2.08元。若只看毛利率數字的跳升幅度，很容易被解讀為單純受惠營收成長；但若進一步拆解產品組合結構，會發現真正驅動這波獲利兌現的，是一項比營收數字更早出現變化的指標——高階鍍膜鑽針占比。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)

根據優分析產業資料庫追蹤的季度數據，尖點高階鍍膜鑽針占比從2025年第四季的48%，一路提升至2026年上半年的56%，提前超越公司原先設定的全年55%目標。將這項占比數字與同期毛利率並列觀察，可以看到明顯的連動關係：2025年第四季毛利率34.84%，2026年第一季隨鍍膜占比升至53%而拉高到36.59%，第二季鍍膜占比再升至56%，毛利率同步跳升至41.78%。大致上，鍍膜占比每提升約5個百分點，毛利率便隨之增加約3至5個百分點。
這項連動關係背後的原因，與AI伺服器主機板的結構特性有關。相較於手機板鑽針壽命可達1萬孔以上，AI伺服器GPU主板因層數高達26至40層，鑽針壽命驟降至2,000孔以內，磨損速度大幅提升。這使得原本屬於選配性質的鍍膜鑽針，逐漸轉為AI伺服器應用的標配規格，而鍍膜鑽針的單價與毛利率均明顯高於傳統鑽針。換言之，這波毛利率成長並非單純由訂單量放大帶動，而是反映產品組合本質上的結構性優化。
(圖片來源:尖點法說會簡報)

值得留意的是，這段期間尖點同時面對鎢鋼原料成本自2025年下半年起持續上漲的壓力。公司並未被動吸收成本，而是採取「By Case滾動式機動調整」機制，依料、工、費變化隨時檢視報價；2026年上半年已完成一輪漲價，且公司表示下半年暫無二次漲價規劃，顯示目前報價已一定程度反映成本變化。這項定價彈性的背後，反映的是供需失衡下的賣方市場格局——目前鑽針產能利用率達91%，市場處於缺鑽狀態，短期內尚未看到供需恢復平衡的跡象。在此情況下，尖點不僅具備調價空間，也能同步透過產品組合優化持續墊高平均售價。

面對強勁需求，尖點規劃大幅擴產：月產能將從目前水準提升至2026年底的4,500萬支（基本量），並進一步於2027年底達7,000萬支、2028年底達9,000萬支。對應的2026年資本支出達30億元，是2025年5至6億元規模的5至6倍。大規模資本支出轉入折舊後，通常會對毛利率形成一定壓力，這也是觀察後續獲利品質時需要留意的變數。市場預估2026年毛利率37.46%、2027年39.19%，意味著即使新增產能陸續攤提折舊，毛利率仍可能維持相對高檔，但此預估隱含產品組合持續優化、且需求強度不墜的假設，屬於相對樂觀的情境。

在需求端的訂單保障上，尖點已切入韓系大型PCB客戶供應鏈，並引進欣興(3037-TW)、金像電(2368-TW)、臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)三家策略投資人。這項安排的意義不僅止於資金挹注，更重要的是透過策略入股綁定大客戶訂單，降低未來產能大幅擴張後、實際需求不如預期的風險。若將這項客戶結構與資本支出規劃一併觀察，可以看出尖點目前的擴產節奏，是建立在與下游PCB大廠深度綁定的基礎之上，而非單純押注市場需求延續。

paras_en: Sharp Point (8021-TW) reported a Q2 profit margin of 41.78%, a 12.34% YoY increase, with a single-quarter EPS of NT$2.08. While the profit margin jump may seem solely driven by revenue growth, a closer look at the product mix reveals that the real driver behind this profit realization is a key metric that has shown changes earlier than revenue - the high-end coating drill bit ratio.

According to the data from the Optimize Analysis Industry Database, Sharp Point's high-end coating drill bit ratio has been steadily increasing from 48% in Q4 2025 to 56% in the first half of 2026, surpassing the company's original full-year target of 55%.

When comparing the drill bit ratio with the corresponding profit margin, a clear correlation can be observed: Q4 2025 profit margin was 34.84%, Q1 2026 saw the drill bit ratio rise to 53% and profit margin to 36.59%, and Q2 2026 saw the drill bit ratio rise to 56% and profit margin to 41.78%. In general, for every 5% increase in drill bit ratio, profit margin increases by around 3-5%.

The underlying reason for this correlation lies in the structural characteristics of AI server motherboard. Compared to smartphone motherboard, AI server GPU motherboard has a much higher layer count (up to 26-40 layers), resulting in a significant reduction in drill bit lifespan (down to 2,000 holes or less) and a substantial increase in wear and tear.

This has led to the coating drill bit, which was previously an optional feature, becoming a standard specification for AI server applications. As a result, the single price and profit margin of coating drill bits are significantly higher than those of traditional drill bits.

Notably, during this period, Sharp Point has faced the pressure of rising tungsten steel raw material costs since the second half of 2025. However, the company has not passively absorbed the costs but has adopted a 'By Case' rolling adjustment mechanism to review pricing in response to changes in materials, labor, and other costs.

In the first half of 2026, the company completed a round of price increases and has no plans for a second round of price increases in the second half of the year, indicating that the current pricing has reflected the cost changes to some extent. This pricing flexibility reflects the seller's market structure under supply-demand imbalance, with the current drill bit utilization rate reaching 91% and a shortage of drill bits in the market.

In this situation, Sharp Point not only has room for price adjustments but can also continue to optimize product mix to maintain average selling prices. Despite strong demand, Sharp Point plans to significantly expand production: monthly production capacity will increase from the current level to 45 million units by the end of 2026, and further to 70 million units by the end of 2027 and 90 million units by the end of 2028.

The corresponding capital expenditure for 2026 is NT$3 billion, five to six times the NT$5-6 billion scale of 2025. Large-scale capital expenditures will typically put pressure on profit margins, and this is also a variable that needs to be observed in the subsequent profit quality.

Market estimates for 2026 profit margin are 37.46%, 2027 is 39.19%, indicating that even with the gradual depreciation of new production capacity, profit margins may still remain relatively high, but this estimate assumes continuous product mix optimization and sustained demand intensity, which is a relatively optimistic scenario.
